name: GeneTech Data Engine
displayName: GeneTech 数据引擎 — 14 站前沿科技知识库 MCP
description: Real-time knowledge-base MCP server for the GeneTech 14-site science engine. Lets external AI agents query, search, filter and cite curated entities across 30 vertical domains (genetics, quantum computing, brain science, AI agents, new energy, nuclear energy, TCM tools, and more). Data is continuously collected from PubMed, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, GitHub and HuggingFace and refreshed by an automated ops pipeline.
shortDescription: Query, search, cite and map research gaps across 30 vertical science knowledge bases from any AI agent.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List all GeneTech knowledge sites (domains) with entity counts and last-updated timestamps.

tools.name: query_entities
tools.description: Filter knowledge entities by site, source (pubmed/arxiv/openalex/github/crossref/huggingface), tags, keyword and minimum confidence. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Fetch a single entity by ID with optional BibTeX / APA / RIS citation export.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Hybrid retrieval across the knowledge base: BM25 inverted index + field-weighted scoring + Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Optional vector embedding via GENETECH_EMBED_URL (env-gated). Optional graph_hop expands recall via graph traversal.

tools.name: graph_search
tools.description: Graph traversal retrieval: find anchor nodes via hybridSearch, then BFS multi-hop along entity relation edges, returning the full path explanation. Useful for cross-domain bridging / co-authorship / upstream-downstream questions.

tools.name: export_citation
tools.description: Export any entity as an academic citation in BibTeX, APA or RIS format.

tools.name: citation_gaps
tools.description: Cross-domain citation gap matrix: which site pairs have ZERO citations between them (research-gap candidates), which pairs bridge strongest, and per-site in/out degree. Derived from 25,635 cross-site citation edges; currently 140 gap pairs out of 870 directed pairs (16.1%). Always read gaps together with siteScale to distinguish a genuine research gap from insufficient corpus coverage.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question against the knowledge engine: internal hybrid retrieval + LLM bridge, returns an answer with cited sources. Degrades to an entity digest list when no LLM is configured.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Submit a structured data request so downstream projects can request targeted collection.

tools.name: retrieve_requests
tools.description: Browse / filter / aggregate the data-request queue.

tools.name: intake_health
tools.description: Check the health of the data-request intake queue.

authentication.description: Free tier works without authentication (rate-limited). For the premium API product, set GENETECH_API_KEY on the server and GENETECH_REQUIRE_AUTH=true; clients then pass the key as a Bearer token. The same unified license keys (GUX_*) issued by the unified-license Worker can be reused.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.description: Local / self-hosted MCP server reading the open knowledge base. No key required.

features: Full 30-site knowledge base (300,000 entities) + cross-domain citation gap matrix

tiers.name: Pro (Hosted API)
tiers.description: Hosted remote MCP endpoint with API-key auth, higher rate limits and SLA. Reuses the unified GUX_ license.

env.GENETECH_DATA_DIR: <path to repo root containing the site directories>
env.GENETECH_API_BASE: <optional: https://lm203688.github.io/genetech-14-sites to read from the live site>
